title: OpenDesign 0.26.0 — Share the Work, Bring Feedback Back
body:
Share work and motion videos with your team or clients to view and comment on in the browser—no download required. Send the feedback you receive to an Agent for the next revision.
One link to share work and motion videos
Comment directly on the work to make feedback clearer
Update the work while keeping the same link

zh-CN.title: OpenDesign 0.26.0 — 作品发出去，反馈带回来
zh-CN.body:
把作品和动效视频分享给团队或客户，直接观看、评论，无需下载客户端。收到反馈后，由你交给 Agent 继续修改。
一个链接，分享作品和动效视频
在作品上评论，让反馈更清楚
更新作品，沿用原链接
